overlays.dialogBody: Your new stop applies from tomorrow's trip.

overlays.toastErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

login.brandLead: One account for students, parents, drivers and every university office.
login.featureTracking: Follow your bus live on the map
login.featureCard: Your digital bus pass, always with you
login.featureSafety: Safer trips, with SOS and attendance
login.identifierLead: Enter your ID and we'll text a one-time code to your registered phone. No password needed.
login.identifierLabel: University ID, staff ID or phone
login.identifierHint: Students: your 9-digit university ID. Parents: the phone number registered with the university.
login.identifierRequired: Enter your ID or phone number.
login.identifierTooShort: This looks too short. Check it and try again.
login.phoneLength: Phone numbers are 11 digits starting with 01. Check it and try again.
login.studentIdLength: Student IDs are 9 digits. Check it and try again.
login.codeLead: Hi {name}. We sent a {length}-digit code to <phone>{destination}</phone>.
login.codeExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
login.resent: A new code is on its way.
login.help: Can't sign in? Contact the Transportation office.

errors.otpRateLimited: Please wait a minute before asking for another code.

session.homeLead: You're signed in. Your office's pages are being built and will open here.

home.lead: Your university bus, in one place.

subscription.title: My subscription
subscription.noneBody: Pick a line and a stop, then pay within 24 hours to keep your seat.
subscription.reservedBody: Pay {amount} and upload the receipt before the hold ends, or the seat goes to someone else.
subscription.reviewBody: Finance is checking it. Your seat stays held meanwhile, and we'll tell you once it's approved.
subscription.expiredBody: The seat was released because no receipt arrived in time. You can book again.
subscription.cancelledBody: You can book another line or stop.

steps.title: How to subscribe
steps.pay: Pay at the bank, or by Visa in room A045
steps.upload: Upload the receipt and wait for approval

trip.title: Next trip
trip.approaching: On the way to your stop, about {time}
trip.passed_stop: Picked up, heading to campus, about {time}

lines.lead: Every line costs {price} a term. Buses reach campus between {from} and {to}.
lines.searchPlaceholder: Area or line number, e.g. Nasr City or 12
lines.noResultsBody: Try another area name or line number.
lines.seatsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
lines.alreadyBooked: You already have a booking on {line}.
lines.estimateNote: Seat counts are estimates until the bus company confirms each bus.

line.stopsLead: Pick the stop where you'll get on.
line.stopsLeadReadOnly: In the order the bus passes them.
line.noLocation: Map pins come once the Transportation office sends the stop locations.
line.notFoundBody: This line doesn't exist or was removed.

booking.title: Book a seat
booking.chooseStop: Choose your stop from the list.
booking.hold: We hold the seat for 24 hours while you pay.
booking.fullBody: No seats left this term. Choose another line, or ask the Transportation office (room A039).
booking.alreadyBody: One subscription per term. To change it, cancel your unpaid booking first.

confirm.title: Book a seat on {line}?
confirm.body: Stop: {stop}, pickup {time}. Price: {price}. You'll have 24 hours to pay and upload the receipt.

line.bookedBody: Pay within 24 hours to keep it.

errors.SEAT_UNAVAILABLE: Someone just took the last seat. Pick another line.
errors.ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED: You already have a booking this term.
errors.STOP_NOT_ON_LINE: That stop isn't on this line any more. Reload and choose again.
errors.LINE_NOT_FOUND: This line was removed. Choose another one.
errors.network: No connection. Your seat wasn't booked; try again.
errors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't book the seat. Try again.

booking.cancelBody: Your seat on {line} will be released, and you can book another line or stop.
booking.cancelError: We couldn't cancel the booking. Try again.

payment.lead: Pay the term fee to activate your subscription.
payment.noBookingBody: Choose a line and a stop, then come back here to pay.
payment.expiredBody: No receipt arrived in time, so the seat was released. Book again to pay.
payment.reviewBody: Finance is checking it. Your seat stays held until they decide.
payment.reviewDemo: Test mode: to decide it, sign in as Finance (FIN-1001) and open Payments.
payment.rejectedBody: {reason} Your seat is held again for 24 hours: upload a correct receipt.
payment.onlyTheseMethods: Only these two ways are accepted. There is no Fawry or InstaPay.

bank.title: Bank deposit or transfer
bank.lead: Deposit at any National Bank of Egypt branch, or transfer to this account. A direct deposit is best: transfers can take days to show.

office.title: Visa card at the university
office.body: Pay by card at the Accounting office, room {room}. {hours}.
office.after: Finance records the payment, and your subscription activates once it's confirmed. Then pass by the Transportation office, room {room}, if they ask you to confirm your details.

receipt.title: Upload the receipt
receipt.lead: The receipt must clearly show the student's name, the amount, your university ID, the account holder's name, the line and the stop.
receipt.referenceHint: The operation or slip number printed on the receipt.
receipt.payerHint: Often a parent's name, as it appears on the receipt.
receipt.fileHint: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to {size}.
receipt.amountTooLow: The amount must be at least {amount}.
receipt.dateInFuture: The date can't be in the future.
receipt.fileType: Only JPG, PNG or PDF files.
receipt.sentBody: Finance will review it. Your seat stays held meanwhile.

errors.HOLD_EXPIRED: Your hold ended before the receipt arrived. Book again.
errors.NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT: This booking isn't waiting for a payment any more. Reload the page.
errors.RECEIPT_ALREADY_USED: This receipt was already used. Check the reference number.
errors.RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Send a smaller photo.
errors.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The amount is less than the term price.
errors.network: No connection. Nothing was sent; try again.
errors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't send the receipt. Try again.

receipt.amountInvalid: Write the amount in pounds, with at most two digits for piasters (for example 15000 or 15000.50).
receipt.amountTooHigh: That's more than {maximum}. Check the amount on the receipt.
receipt.dateTooEarly: The date can't be before you held the seat ({date}).

card.lead: Show this to the driver or supervisor when you get on the bus.
card.lockedTitle: Your card opens after you subscribe
card.lockedBody: Book a seat and pay. Once finance approves your receipt, your card appears here.
card.reviewBody: Your pass appears here as soon as Finance approves the receipt. You'll get a notification.
card.payBody: Your seat is held. Pay and upload the receipt; the pass opens once Finance approves it.
card.expired: This code has expired. Connect to the internet to get a new one.
card.tip: The code changes every 30 seconds, so a screenshot won't work. Turn your screen brightness up when you scan.

offline.title: Your card (saved on this phone)
offline.name: Name
offline.noCode: No internet, so there's no boarding code. Show these details to the driver, or connect to get the code.

requests.title: Requests
requests.lead: Change your line, ask for a refund or a permit to bring a project model on the bus, and follow each request until the office answers.
requests.emptyBody: Need a different line for a while, or have to cancel your subscription? Start a request above.
requests.needsActiveBody: Line changes and refunds are for students whose subscription is paid and active.
requests.sentBody: You'll get a notification when the office answers.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter an 11-digit mobile number starting 010, 011, 012 or 015.
errors.guardianSameAsStudent: That's your own number. Enter your guardian's number.
errors.textTooShort: Write a little more (at least 10 characters).
errors.dateInPast: The date can't be in the past.
errors.dateInFuture: The date can't be in the future.
errors.dateBeforeTerm: The date must be in this term.
errors.dateAfterTerm: The date is after the end of the term.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date.
errors.consentRequired: Your guardian must agree before you send this.
errors.documentsRequired: Attach the supporting document (medical report, certificate or transfer letter).
errors.fileType: JPG, PNG or PDF files only.
errors.fileTooLarge: Each file must be {size} or less.
errors.exitBeforeEntry: The exit must be after the entry.
errors.declarationRequired: Accept the declaration before you send the permit.

serverErrors.NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION: Your subscription isn't active, so this request can't be sent.
serverErrors.REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open request of this kind. Wait for its answer or withdraw it first.
serverErrors.INVALID_DATES: Check the dates: they must be within this term.
serverErrors.REFUND_WINDOW_CLOSED: Ordinary refunds are closed for this term. Only exceptional cases can be sent.
serverErrors.DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED: Attach the supporting document for this reason.
serverErrors.NOT_WITHDRAWABLE: The office has already started on this request.
serverErrors.LINE_NOT_FOUND: That line no longer exists. Choose another.
serverErrors.STOP_NOT_ON_LINE: That stop isn't on the line. Choose again.
serverErrors.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again; nothing was sent twice.
serverErrors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
serverErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
serverErrors.NO_SUBSCRIPTION: Book a seat first: complaints are for students with a booking.
serverErrors.NOT_AWAITING_GUARDIAN: This request isn't waiting for the guardian any more.

guardian.title: Guardian's approval
guardian.name: Guardian's name
guardian.consentLineChange: My guardian agrees to this line change
guardian.consentRefund: My guardian agrees to cancel the subscription and get the refund
guardian.consentHint: The university's form needs the guardian's approval. The office may call to confirm.
guardian.lineChangeNote: Once you send it, your guardian gets it in the app to approve. Only then does it go to the Transportation office.

lineChange.title: Line change request
lineChange.lead: The university's line change form, online. Choose the new line and stop, for good or for a few days.
lineChange.toLineHint: A line with free seats is approved faster.
lineChange.lineOption: {line} ({seats, plural, =0 {0 free seats} one {# free seat} other {# free seats}})
lineChange.toStopHint: Where you'll get on or off the new line.
lineChange.permanentHint: For the rest of the term.
lineChange.temporaryHint: For a few days, then back to your line.
lineChange.reason: Why do you need to change?

refund.title: Refund request
refund.lead: Cancel your paid subscription and get money back under this term's refund policy.

medical.label: Health condition, disability or injury
medical.hint: Decided by the university. Attach a medical report.

bereavement.label: Death in the family
bereavement.hint: Decided by the university. Attach the certificate.

transfer.label: Moving to another university
transfer.hint: Attach the transfer letter. The terms and conditions apply.

refund.needsPaidBody: A refund is for a subscription that is paid and active. Unpaid bookings can simply be cancelled from the home page.
refund.ruleCheque: The money is paid by a cheque in the guardian's name within {days} days.
refund.ruleProcessing: The office processes a request in {days} working days.
refund.ruleOriginalReceipt: Bring the original payment receipt to the Transportation office (A039).
refund.ruleExceptional: Death, health conditions and disability are left to the university's judgement, with documents.
refund.closedBody: Since November 1, 100% of the fee is deducted. You can still ask for an exceptional case below.
refund.documentsHint: Medical report, certificate or transfer letter. JPG, PNG or PDF, up to {size} each.
refund.cancelWarning: If the refund is approved, your subscription ends and your card stops working.
refund.confirmTitle: Cancel your subscription for a refund?
refund.confirmBody: If it's approved, your subscription ends, your pass stops working and you can't ride the bus.
refund.confirmOpenLineChange: You still have an open line change request ({reference}). If the refund is approved, that line change won't matter any more.

complaint.title: Complaints
complaint.lead: Tell the Transportation office about a problem on the bus. Every complaint gets an answer.
complaint.emptyBody: If something goes wrong on your bus, tell us here.
complaint.newLead: What happened, when and on which line. Photos help.
complaint.safetyBody: Call the Transportation office at 01040772030 or tell the supervisor at once. This form is for follow-up.
complaint.descriptionHint: Time, stop and what you saw. At least 10 characters.
complaint.attachmentsHint: Up to 3 files: JPG, PNG or PDF, {size} each.
complaint.onlyPayment: Until your subscription is active you can only complain about a payment or receipt.
complaint.needsBookingBody: Complaints are for students with a booking. If you have a question before booking, call the Transportation office at 01040772030.

detail.waitingBody: The Transportation office will open your request soon. You can still withdraw it until then.
detail.withdrawHint: Changed your mind? You can withdraw the request until the office opens it.
detail.withdrawConfirmBody: {reference} will be closed. You can send a new one later.

withdrawErrors.NOT_WITHDRAWABLE: The office has already started on it, so it can't be withdrawn.
withdrawErrors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.

detail.guardianWaitingBody: Your guardian has it in the app. Once they approve, it goes to the Transportation office. You can withdraw it until the office opens it.
detail.guardianApproved: Your guardian approved; sent to the Transportation office

modelPermit.title: Project model permit
modelPermit.lead: The university's safety permit to bring a project model onto the bus, online. Your doctor or TA and the Safety department sign it.
modelPermit.needsActiveBody: The permit is for your own bus, so you need a paid, active subscription.
modelPermit.driverByOffice: The Transportation office adds the driver's name and mobile.
modelPermit.destinationHint: Where the model goes, e.g. the project exhibition, building B.
modelPermit.supervisorName: Doctor / TA responsible for the project
modelPermit.supervisorHint: They sign first, then the Safety department.
modelPermit.declarationIntro: I, {name}, university ID {id}, accept full responsibility while carrying the model (project) on the university bus, and I undertake to:

pledges.protectModel: Protect the model and not cause any damage or harm to myself or to others.
pledges.noSeatDamage: Not tear the bus upholstery or seats.
pledges.keepAisleClear: Not injure any student or block the aisle inside the bus.
pledges.noDanger: Not put my life or the lives of others in any danger.
pledges.noHazardousMaterials: Not use any flammable materials, materials with strong odours, or materials that cause suffocation inside the bus.

modelPermit.declarationOutro: I understand that breaking these instructions may lead to the Code of Conduct being applied.

notGoing.title: Not going today
notGoing.lead: Tell us before the bus leaves, so the driver doesn't wait for you and you aren't marked absent.
notGoing.needsActiveBody: Once your subscription is active you can tell us the days you won't ride.
notGoing.noDaysTitle: No day to report right now
notGoing.noDaysBody: Every service day in the next week is already reported, or today's bus already left.
notGoing.cutoff: You can report or take it back until {time}, when the bus leaves the first stop of your line.
notGoing.whoKnowsBody: Your driver and bus supervisor, your guardian and the Transportation office. That day counts as "not going", not absent.
notGoing.confirmBody: The driver won't wait for you at your stop. You can take it back until the bus leaves.
notGoing.sentBody: We told the driver, your guardian and the office about {day}.
notGoing.upcomingLead: From today on. Past days are in My trips.
notGoing.upcomingEmpty: Nothing reported. You're riding every day.
notGoing.cancelConfirmBody: We'll tell the driver and your guardian that you're coming.

errors.DATE_NOT_REPORTABLE: Pick a service day within the next week.
errors.ABSENCE_CUTOFF_PASSED: The bus already left, so this day can't be changed.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.

myTrips.title: My trips
myTrips.lead: Every trip this term: when you got on, when the bus reached campus, and the days you missed.
myTrips.emptyBody: Your trips show up here once your subscription is active and you ride.
myTrips.returnNote: Return trips will show here once the Transportation office publishes return times.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.lead: Ask about your line, times and the bus rules, in English or Arabic.
assistant.soonBody: It is being built and will open here. Until then, your line, times and announcements are in the app, and the Transportation office (A039) answers anything else.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: Your bus, your payments and answers to your requests, all in one place.
notifications.markAllFailed: Couldn't mark them as read. Try again.
notifications.emptyBody: When your bus is near, your payment is reviewed or the office answers a request, you'll see it here.
notifications.leadParent: When your children get on the bus, reach campus, miss the bus or won't ride, and notices for their lines.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.lead: Notices from the Transportation office: official news, delays and changes to lines.
announcements.emptyBody: Nothing of this type has been announced yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Your account, language and how the app looks.
settings.accountHint: From the university's records. To correct anything, visit the Transportation office (A039).
settings.languageHint: The whole app, including dates and messages from the office.
settings.appearanceHint: "Device" follows your phone or laptop's light or dark setting.
settings.signOutHint: You'll need a new code by SMS to sign in again.

bus.title: Bus and driver
bus.phoneHidden: The driver's number shows here for this line's subscribers.

tracking.studentLead: Where your bus is now, from the GPS device in the bus.
tracking.noSubscriptionTitle: {who, select, self {You aren't subscribed yet} other {{name} has no subscription}}
tracking.noSubscriptionBody: {who, select, self {Book a seat on a line to follow your bus here.} other {Once a seat is booked and paid, you'll follow the bus here.}}
tracking.noTripTitle: The bus isn't on the road now
tracking.noTripBody: The next trip starts {time}. The map comes alive a few minutes before.
tracking.noTripBodyUnknown: The map comes alive a few minutes before the next trip.

status.approaching: On the way to {who, select, self {your stop} other {{name}'s stop}} ({stop}), about {time}
status.passed_stop: Past {who, select, self {your stop} other {{name}'s stop}}, reaching campus in about {time}

tracking.noStopPins: Stop pins appear once the Transportation office sends their locations.
tracking.demoNote: Test mode: the bus position is made up. In the real app it comes from the GPS device in the bus.

parent.noChildrenBody: Your phone number isn't on any student's file. Contact the Transportation office (A039).

home.lead: How each of your children's day is going, and the bus live.
home.noSubscription: {name} has no bus booking this term.

day.title: Today's trip
day.lead: Boarding, arrival and anything unusual, as it happens.

no_subscription.title: {name} has no bus subscription
no_subscription.body: Once a seat is booked and paid, today's trip shows here.

not_going.title: {name} won't ride today
not_going.body: They said so in the app at {time}. The driver and the office know.

bus_on_way.title: The bus is on its way to {stop}

boarded.title: On the bus since {time}
boarded.body: Card scanned at {stop}. The bus is heading to campus.

checked_out.title: Left the bus on the way at {time}
checked_out.body: The reason is in today's details.

absent.title: {name} wasn't on the bus today
absent.body: The bus reached campus without their card being scanned, and they hadn't reported a day off.

event.absent: Marked absent: not on the bus

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lead: Your children's line change requests. A request reaches the Transportation office only after you approve it.
approvals.emptyBody: When one of your children asks to change line, it shows here and you get a notification.
approvals.explain: If you approve, it goes to the Transportation office, which checks the seats. If you refuse, it's closed and {name} is told.
approvals.approveBody: {name}'s request for {line} goes to the Transportation office.
approvals.refuseBody: The request is closed. {name} can send a new one later.
approvals.approveNote: A note for the Transportation office
approvals.approvedToastBody: {name}'s request went to the Transportation office.
approvals.changeHint: You can change your mind until {time}, as long as the Transportation office hasn't opened the request.

errors.NOT_AWAITING_GUARDIAN: This request was already answered or withdrawn.
errors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.

gate.noBusTitle: You're not on a bus today
gate.noBusBody: The Transportation office hasn't assigned you to a bus. Call them if you think this is wrong.
gate.noServiceBody: Buses run Sunday to Thursday. Your trip shows here on the next working day.

checkout.title: Check out a student
checkout.body: Their guardian is told at once. The university's responsibility ends when they leave the bus.
checkout.reasonRequired: Choose why the student is leaving first.

trip.title: Today's trip

sosOpenBody.open: Waiting for the Transportation office to take it.
sosOpenBody.acknowledged: The Transportation office has it. Keep your phone close.

trip.startedToast: Trip started. Students and guardians were told.
trip.blocked: End the trip on the road first.

errors.OTHER_TRIP_IN_PROGRESS: End the trip on the road first.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.DRIVER_RELIEVED: The Transportation office handed this trip to another driver, so you can't run it.

trip.startConfirmBody: Students and guardians on the line are told the bus left.
trip.offTimeLate: This trip is due at {time}, so you're about {hours, plural, =1 {an hour} other {# hours}} late. Make sure it's the right trip before you start.
trip.offTimeEarly: This trip is due at {time}, about {hours, plural, =1 {an hour} other {# hours}} from now. Make sure it's the right trip before you start.
trip.endConfirmWaiting: {count, plural, one {# student wasn't scanned and will be marked absent.} other {# students weren't scanned and will be marked absent.}} Their guardians are told.
trip.endConfirmAll: Everyone on the list is accounted for.
trip.stopsLead: Students still to pick up at each stop.
trip.stopsLeadReturn: Students still to board, by their stop.
trip.toPickUp: {count, plural, =0 {None left} one {# to pick up} other {# to pick up}}
trip.relievedTitle: The office handed your bus to another driver
trip.relievedBody: Since {time}, {name} ({phone}) is driving. You can't start or end the trip or scan passes any more. Call the Transportation office if anything is wrong.

scan.title: Scan cards
scan.lead: Point the camera at the student's pass. Each pass works for 30 seconds only.
scan.noTripBody: Start the trip first, then scan each student as they get on.
scan.boardHint: Scan each student as they get on the bus.
scan.checkoutHint: Scan a student who is leaving before the end of the trip, then pick the reason.
scan.manualLead: If the student's phone is off, type their university ID. It's recorded as entered by hand.

errors.CARD_INVALID: This isn't a SUtech bus pass.
errors.CARD_EXPIRED: The pass expired. Ask the student to open it again (no screenshots).
errors.STUDENT_NOT_FOUND: No student with this university ID.
errors.NOT_ON_THIS_TRIP: Not subscribed on this line. Send them to the Transportation office.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.DRIVER_RELIEVED: The Transportation office handed this trip to another driver, so you can't scan.

camera.lead: The back camera reads the QR code on the student's pass.
camera.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings, or type the ID below.
camera.unavailable: The camera can't open here. It needs the app's secure (https) address. Type the ID below meanwhile.

passengers.title: Passengers
passengers.lead: Everyone subscribed on your line, by stop.
passengers.boardConfirmBody: Only when the student is on the bus but can't show the pass. It's recorded as entered by hand.

delay.title: Report a delay
delay.lead: Students and guardians on your line get a notice right away.
delay.noteHint: Where you are now, or anything students should know.
delay.whoKnowsBody: A delay notice goes on your line's announcements, and every student and guardian on the line gets a notification.

errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.invalid: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.DELAY_OUT_OF_WINDOW: A delay can be sent while the trip runs, or within an hour of its pickup time.
errors.DRIVER_RELIEVED: The Transportation office handed this trip to another driver. They or the supervisor report delays now.

delay.sentBody: Students and guardians on your line were told.
delay.sentListEmpty: No delays reported on this trip.
delay.closedTitle: Too far from the trip's time
delay.closedBody: You can report a delay while the trip runs, or from an hour before its pickup time ({time}) to an hour after.

sos.title: SOS emergency
sos.lead: For a real emergency only. The Transportation office gets it at once with the bus's location.
sos.noTripBody: Today's trips have ended. In an emergency, call the numbers here.
sos.pickLead: Press the one that fits. You'll confirm before it's sent.

medical.label: Medical
medical.hint: Someone on board needs a doctor. The clinic is told too.

breakdown.label: Bus problem
